evals.prompt: Write a hook for the new Swap CTA on the transmuter page. It should take an input asset denom, output asset denom, and amount, then execute a transmuter swap. Put it in components/Transmuter/hooks/useTransmuterSwap.ts
evals.expected_output: A CTA hook following the three-layer pattern (useQuery for msgs, useSimulateAndBroadcast, cache invalidation on success) with correct imports, enabled gates, and return shape { action, msgs }
assertions: Uses useQuery for message building (not useMutation)
Imports and calls useSimulateAndBroadcast (no custom simulation)
Returns { action, msgs } matching codebase convention
Has enabled gates on both message query and simulation
Invalidates cache on success via queryClient.invalidateQueries with targeted prefixes
Query keys use only primitives (no objects)

evals.prompt: The disco page keeps refetching slot data every time I switch browser tabs or come back to the window. It's hammering the RPC. Can you figure out what's wrong and fix it?
evals.expected_output: Identifies missing or insufficient staleTime on the relevant disco data queries, adds appropriate staleTime values, and possibly adjusts refetchOnWindowFocus behavior
assertions: Diagnoses staleTime as the root cause of refetching on tab focus
Adds staleTime to relevant queries with appropriate tier values (not arbitrary)
Changes are targeted - doesn't wholesale rewrite unrelated code

evals.prompt: I need a new service function to fetch acquisition reward history from the contract (query msg: { get_reward_history: { user } }) and a corresponding React hook. Follow the existing patterns in the codebase.
evals.expected_output: A service function with mock data fallback, null client handling, contract address validation, and console.error on failure. Plus a useQuery hook with appropriate staleTime, enabled gate, appState.rpcUrl in query key.
assertions: Service returns null on error (not throwing)
Service has mock data fallback with USE_MOCK_DATA flag and simulated delay
Service validates client for null before querying
Hook includes appState.rpcUrl in query key for multi-chain cache separation
Hook has appropriate staleTime set (not relying on defaults)
Hook has enabled gate to prevent premature fetching
